documents.title: 09 — NLP for the Store: NLTK and spaCy

mostPositive.text: Growth now comes from taking share.
Wellness & sleep; Sleep masks, mouth tape, posture correctors, massage tools, at-home wellness kits; High perceived value, consumable re-orders; Health claims are regulated (FTC/FDA).

mostNegative.text: Low return/defect risk — small, light, non-fragile, no sizing complexity, no batteries if possible.

mostPositive.text: Good for comfort, wellness, home and gift products.

mostNegative.text: Mobile-first checkout: Shop Pay, Apple Pay, PayPal, buy-now-pay-later (Klarna/Afterpay) for $50+ orders.

mostPositive.text: Identify a gap: better bundle, better content, faster shipping, guarantee, niche focus.

mostNegative.text: AliExpress; Same supplier catalog dropshippers use; Slow shipping to the US, poor customer service.

mostPositive.text: Product samples; Always order samples of hero products.

mostNegative.text: Start on Basic; move to Grow when monthly revenue reaches ~$10–15k (the lower card rate pays for the plan difference).

mostPositive.text: Bookkeeping & tax; Reconciliation, sales tax, profit tracking; Profit app + accountant at year end; Monthly bookkeeper; Bookkeeper + CPA.
Category: health & beauty converts higher (~3% top quartile) than electronics (~1.8%).

mostNegative.text: No fake reviews or bought testimonials — FTC Consumer Review Rule allows civil penalties up to ~$53,088 per violation; FTC sent warning letters in late 2025.

mostPositive.text: Chargebacks and refunds — "item not received", "not as described"; Realistic delivery promises, proactive tracking emails, quality samples, responsive support, chargeback alerts (e.g.

mostNegative.text: IP infringement — selling knockoffs, using trademarked names or stolen images; Own photos/videos; no branded knockoffs; trademark search on our brand name.

mostPositive.text: This project uses two open-source Python libraries, each for what it does best.

mostNegative.text: Negations and sarcasm can fool it.
